title: Willingdon Dam, Junagadh - A Serene Escape Amid Nature
content:
Willingdon Dam, Junagadh

Nestled at the foothills of the Girnar Mountains, Willingdon Dam is one of the most scenic and peaceful spots in Junagadh, Gujarat. Built across the Kalwa River, this historic dam is not just an essential water source for the region but also a beloved picnic destination. Surrounded by lush greenery, gentle hills, and chirping birds, it offers a refreshing break from city life - perfect for nature lovers, photographers, and peace seekers.

History & Significance

Named after Lord Willingdon, the then Governor of India, the dam was constructed during the British era to supply water to the Junagadh region. Over the years, it has evolved from being a functional structure to a scenic retreat for locals and tourists alike. The tranquil environment and breathtaking backdrop of Girnar make it one of the must-visit places in Junagadh.

Best Time to Visit

The best time to explore Willingdon Dam is between October and February, when the weather is cool and pleasant. During the monsoon season (July to September), the dam overflows with water, creating a mesmerizing view - though visitors should be cautious due to slippery trails.

Timings & Entry Fee

  • Timings: 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM (Open all days)
  • Entry Fee: No entry fee

How to Reach

  • By Road: Willingdon Dam is about 5 km from Junagadh city center. Auto-rickshaws and taxis are easily available.
  • By Train: The Junagadh Junction Railway Station is the nearest railhead, just 6 km away.
  • By Air: The nearest airport is Rajkot Airport, around 100 km from Junagadh.

Things to Do at Willingdon Dam

  • Enjoy a peaceful morning walk or evening stroll.
  • Capture panoramic photos of the dam and the Girnar Hills.
  • Visit nearby attractions like Girnar Hills, Damodar Kund, and Darbar Hall Museum.
  • Relax under the shade of trees and enjoy the tranquil environment.
